senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. חַמָּה) solar columns, [prob. a phallus, cmp. חֲנִיסְנְסַיָּא]. Sifra B’har ch. IX, end (ref. to לא תקימו, Lev. XXVI, 1) אלו הח׳ וכ׳ that means the ḥammanim on roof-tops. Mekh. Bo, s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XII, 2 משכי מחַמָּנֵיכֶם withdraw from your ḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 6">Ib. s. 6</cite> <he>מן הח׳</he> (ed. Weiss a. Fr. everywhere <he>ע״ז</he>).
